name: The Admiral's Orders
summary: Gar'Thok sends you to carry Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Orgrimmar. The orders raise fears of another human landing on Horde shores.

sections.title: A Warning for Nazgrel
sections.body: Gar'Thok in Durotar fears that Admiral Proudmoore's plans still threaten the Horde. He sends you with the admiral's orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: In Thrall's Chamber
sections.body: Nazgrel receives the orders and says the Warchief must hear of the matter at once. He thanks you for serving the Horde honorably, then turns to counsel Thrall.

faq.answer: Gar'Thok sends you from Durotar to deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel.
Nazgrel is to receive Admiral Proudmoore's Orders in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.
Gar'Thok fears that Admiral Proudmoore's plans may bring more of his men to Horde shores.

faq.q: What does Nazgrel do with the warning?
faq.answer: Nazgrel says he must counsel Thrall about the matter.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you carry a warning that Gar'Thok believes concerns the safety of Horde shores.
